subject: Promo code distribution & post-webinar credit mapping
messages:
From: Sara Klein <sara@brightbridge.io>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-14T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Campaign request: 500 attendee promo codes for 10/28 community webinar

Hi Karthik and Marissa,

Thanks again for chatting earlier. BrightBridge is running a community webinar on Oct 28 and wed like to offer 500 attendee promo codes that grant an extended trial (so attendees can try Redwood Inference after the session). Can you confirm: 1) what the credits look like (token amount / trial length), 2) whether we can do a staged release (first 50 codes to a VIP list, then the remainder), and 3) how we prefer delivery (CSV of codes vs. single-use links)?

Logistics: we expect ~900 signups, but want to cap distribution at 500 codes and reserve 20 for speakers. We also need simple redemption tracking so we can see signups mapped back to registration emails for post-event follow-up.

Can you confirm costs or approvals needed on your end? Were working with marketing ops and may need this live by Oct 20 to sync the registration confirmation email.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Sara

--
Sara Klein
Partnerships, BrightBridge Events
Sara@brightbridge.io
+1 415-555-0198
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Klein <sara@brightbridge.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-14T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Campaign request: 500 attendee promo codes for 10/28 community webinar

Sara — thanks for the details. We can support this; below is a recommended plan and what I need from you to finalize.

Proposal (high-level):
- Total allocation: 500 single-use promo codes that credit an account with a 60-day trial extension + $150 in usage credits (sufficient for prototyping).
- Canary release: first 50 codes delivered as a separate CSV (VIP list) — well activate monitoring on those to watch redemptions and any suspicious patterns.
- Delivery format: we prefer a CSV with code, expiry, and a short instruction URL; we can also produce single-use redemption links if youd rather not host codes.
- Tracking: we will accept a mapping file (registration_email -> code) or you can pass us the registration export and we will map post-facto. If you want live attribution inside your confirmation email, we can hand you the CSV to embed codes into the confirmation flow.

What I need from you:
1) Confirm whether you want codes or single-use links.
2) Provide the VIP list (first 50) as a CSV by Oct 19.
3) Confirm if speakers 20 reserved codes should come out of the 500 or be additive.

Notes on security & controls: we will rate-limit redemptions to reduce abuse, and can set a redemption window (I recommend 90 days from issuance). If you need IP restrictions or allowlist, let us know and well add that to the issuance policy.

Attached: draft promo_codes_list.csv (sample format) and MAP_template.xlsx (mapping template).

If that looks good Ill queue the issuance with Ops and send the CSV back to you and your event team.

Thanks — Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Developer Marketing, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Klein <sara@brightbridge.io>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-15T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Campaign request: 500 attendee promo codes for 10/28 community webinar

Sara — quick operational notes from ops/fulfillment:

1) Canary subset: we can do 50 VIP codes now; please send the CSV with header (email, first_name, last_name) by EOD Oct 19 and well return the mapped codes within 24 hours.
2) Main batch: we will stage the remaining 450 in two waves (200 on Oct 21, 250 on Oct 26) to reduce load and give you flexibility.
3) Redemption TTL: default 90 days. If youd prefer 60 days (to match Karthiks recommendation), say the word.
4) Reporting: we will provide a daily redemptions report (CSV) for 14 days post-webinar and a final mapping file with HubSpot contact IDs if you share the HubSpot export link or a shared Drive folder.

Security: we will flag suspicious redemption spikes and hold suspect codes for manual review; any suspicious accounts will be reported to you immediately.

Can you share the Eventbrite link and confirm whether the 20 speaker codes are additive? Also, give us the preferred sender email for the confirmation message so the branding matches.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Sara Klein <sara@brightbridge.io>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-16T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Campaign request: 500 attendee promo codes for 10/28 community webinar

Thanks Karthik and Marissa — this looks great. Answers below: 

- Delivery format: CSV mapping (email -> code) is preferred. Well embed the code into the confirmation email.
- VIP/Canary: VIP 50 is confirmed; the speaker 20 should be additive (so total allocation = 520).
- TTL: 60 days preferred.
- Event link: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/brightbridge-community-night-2026-1234567890
- HubSpot: Ill drop the registration export to the shared Drive link you provided by EOD Oct 19.

If you can produce the VIP CSV by Oct 20 well include it in the confirmation send. Appreciate the monitoring plan — please flag anything unusual during the first 72 hours after code issuance.

Sara

--
Sara Klein
Partnerships, BrightBridge Events
